note: Working search query patterns discovered by the scout. WebFetch to ATS/board domains now generally works (network access confirmed widened again as of 2026-09-03 run #2), but many company career sites are JS-rendered SPAs whose static HTML/markdown extract has no per-job detail (Ashby, Calendly/GitLab/Formation Bio/Anaplan on job-boards.greenhouse.io's newer template, Google careers, StubHub/ASAPP/Nominal/Ro on jobs.lever.co all returned board-index text or 403/404 instead of job detail). Prefer each ATS's public JSON API over the HTML page when possible (see below). Re-check egress/rendering access each run in case it changes.

working_fetch_patterns.greenhouse: Use https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<board_token>/jobs/<job_id> (plain JSON, no auth) instead of the HTML job page — works reliably when the board_token is correct (confirmed for 'cribl', 'gitlab'). 404 on this endpoint for 'calendly', 'formationbio', 'anaplan', 'fastly' this run — those board_tokens may differ from the obvious guess, or those companies have migrated off standard Greenhouse job-boards. HTML job pages at boards.greenhouse.io/* and job-boards.greenhouse.io/* redirect (301) to job-boards.greenhouse.io/* and for older/smaller boards (e.g. pdtpartners) render fine as HTML; for larger boards (calendly, gitlab, formationbio, anaplan) the HTML page renders as a full job list/board index with no way to isolate the single job from WebFetch's markdown conversion — use the API instead.
working_fetch_patterns.lever: Direct job HTML at jobs.lever.co/<co>/<uuid> returned 403 this run. The public API https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/<co>?mode=json (list) or .../<co>/<uuid>?mode=json (single) works when the company slug is exact — confirmed working for 'asapp' (not 'asapp-2'), 'ro'. 404'd for 'stubhub', 'stubhub2', 'nominal' — slug guesses were wrong; try the list endpoint with slug variants before giving up.
working_fetch_patterns.ashby: https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<job_board_name> (case-sensitive board name, e.g. 'Clera' not 'clera') returns full JSON job list including description — works reliably and is much better than the JS-only jobs.ashbyhq.com HTML page (which WebFetch sees as just 'Jobs' with no content).
working_fetch_patterns.bloomberg: bloomberg.avature.net/careers/JobDetail/<slug>/<id> is directly WebFetch-reachable and gives title/location/live-status reliably (no posted date shown on the page).
working_fetch_patterns.twosigma: careers.twosigma.com/careers/JobDetail/<slug>/<id> reachable, but job IDs from search snippets can be stale/404 — confirmed working for the IDs already in state/two_sigma.json, but ids 10878 and 12744 (from a fresh WebSearch) both 404'd this run despite appearing in search results.
working_fetch_patterns.builtinnyc: www.builtinnyc.com/job/<slug>/<id> reachable; many listings from search snippets are dead ('this job was removed at ...') — always verify, don't trust snippet freshness. Confirmed dead this run: CoreWeave 9003049, Everbridge 6595097, ActionIQ 190690, MongoDB 8880864-not-dead (this one WAS live).
working_fetch_patterns.google_careers: www.google.com/about/careers/applications/jobs/results/<id> is JS-rendered — WebFetch only sees nav/header, no job content. Cannot verify Google postings this way; treat fresh Google search snippets as unverified and skip notifying on them unless a future run finds a working access path.
working_fetch_patterns.wellfound: Role/location index pages (wellfound.com/role/l/<role>/<location>) return only aggregate summaries via WebSearch, not individual job URLs — need to click through or find direct /jobs/<id>-<slug> URLs specifically to verify.
